该基本工作流程集合将允许您开始使用 ComfyUI 和新的 SDXS-512-0.9 模型在本地生成图像。

txt2img、img2img 的基本版本和使用我的 Zenkai 系统。更多内容将在下一个合集版本中推出。

它与 SD2.1 Lora 兼容，请务必购买我的 Zenkai 风格 Lora 模型:)

https://civitai.com/models/10003?modelVersionId=79886


安装：

UNETLoader节点：

https://huggingface.co/IDKiro/sdxs-512-0.9/blob/main/unet/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors

重命名为sdxs-512-0.9.safetensors并放置在里面/模型/unet/SDXS/

加载剪辑节点：

https://huggingface.co/IDKiro/sdxs-512-0.9/blob/main/text_encoder/model.safetensors

重命名为Clip_h.safetensors并放置在里面/模型/剪辑/SDXS/

加载VAE节点：

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse-original/blob/main/vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-pruned.safetensors

放在里面/模型/VAE/

o.en:
Article:https://civitai.com/articles/4760

This collection of basic workflows will allow you to get started with Generating images locally using ComfyUI and the new SDXS-512-0.9 model.

Basic versions for txt2img, img2img and using my Zenkai system. More will follow in the next collection version.

It is compatible with SD2.1 Lora's, be sure to grab my Zenkai style Lora model :)

https://civitai.com/models/10003?modelVersionId=79886


Installation:

UNETLoader node:

https://huggingface.co/IDKiro/sdxs-512-0.9/blob/main/unet/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors

rename tosdxs-512-0.9.safetensorsand place inside/models/unet/SDXS/

Load Clip node:

https://huggingface.co/IDKiro/sdxs-512-0.9/blob/main/text_encoder/model.safetensors

rename toclip_h.safetensorsand place inside/models/clip/SDXS/

Load VAE node:

https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-mse-original/blob/main/vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-pruned.safetensors

place inside/models/VAE/
